about: Sky-meter readings for light_pollution.measurements.file (copy to <data_dir>/sky-measurements.json and add your own). Each: lat, lon, date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM / YYYY), and sqm (mag/arcsec^2 at the zenith; or artificialMcdM2). Take readings on clear, moonless nights after astronomical twilight, away from direct lights, and average a few. These 12 are the Ramon Crater dark-sky park's 2020 monitoring sites.
